name: Alert
summary: A message that stays in the content until its cause goes: a section's error with Retry, a warning before a costly step, a success at the end of a journey, an outage banner, a note on a passage. One tinted surface, the tone's icon with its word, a title, the description, actions and an optional Close. Not for an outcome away from where the person is (use `notify()`), a field's error (Field's message), the list of a form's errors (ErrorSummary) or a question that must be answered (an alert Dialog).
a11y: The icon carries the tone's word ("Error", "Warning") so meaning is never colour alone. Silent by default; with `announce` it is a `status` or `alert` live region, mounted with its words so they are said once. Close has a name; when it closes, move focus to what the message was about. The tint is dropped for a full outline in forced colours.

props.name: tone
props.description: What kind of message it is; colour, icon and the spoken word all follow it. Defaults to `info`.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where it sits: `inline` beside what it concerns (words and actions on one line when there is room), `section` at the top of a section or form (actions under the words), `page` a full-width banner at the top of the page or app.

props.name: title
props.description: One short line: what happened or what to know, e.g. "Couldn’t save the address".

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Gives the title a heading level from the page's outline (page banners and section alerts that head a region).

props.name: children
props.description: Why, what was kept and what to do.

props.name: actions
props.description: One or two Buttons or Links: the recovery first (Retry, Review), then the rest.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows Close. Leave it out for a message that must stay while its cause does (an outage, a blocked form).

props.name: icon
props.description: A different icon for the tone's own, or `false` for none (a neutral note never has one by default).

props.name: announce
props.description: Said when it appears after something the person did: `polite` waits for a pause (`role="status"`), `assertive` interrupts (`role="alert"`, only for a failure the person must know now). Leave it out for a message that is there when the page opens: it is read in order, never announced.
